sentence: Report the gap between FRED Brent spot (126.55, 2026-10-14) and the BZ=F front-month settle (105.92, 2026-10-15) as the physical premium of dated Brent over futures that Bernardo says has held through 2026 because of the Iran war and Hormuz risk, not as a data error; note the two prints are for different dates, and flag it only if the gap changes sharply.
